name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: An expansive open-world action RPG where you step into the shoes of Geralt of Rivia, a professional monster hunter. Explore a rich, living world full of morally complex quests, dangerous monsters, and political intrigue. Customize your character's combat skills, alchemy, and magic, and engage in strategic battles against deadly foes.

name: Cyberpunk 2077
description: Set in the dystopian Night City, Cyberpunk 2077 is a sprawling open-world RPG where you play as V, a mercenary seeking a unique implant that grants immortality. Features deep customization, thrilling combat with futuristic weapons, hacking skills, and impactful choices that shape the world.

name: DOOM Eternal
description: DOOM Eternal is a fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping first-person shooter where you play as the Doom Slayer. Battle hordes of demons across multiple dimensions using an extensive arsenal of high-powered weapons. Master movement, precision shooting, and strategic resource management to survive epic boss battles.

name: Minecraft
description: Minecraft is a globally acclaimed sandbox game that allows players to build and explore limitless worlds. Gather resources, craft tools, and construct anything from simple homes to magnificent cities. Survive against monsters, explore diverse biomes, and play solo or with friends in multiplayer servers.

name: Grand Theft Auto V
description: Grand Theft Auto V is an open-world action-adventure game following three criminals in Los Santos. Switch between characters in real-time to complete missions, heists, and side quests. Features high-octane car chases, shootouts, and GTA Online multiplayer mode.

name: Fortnite
description: Fortnite is a free-to-play battle royale game where 100 players compete to be the last person standing. Build structures, fortify positions, and gather weapons on a constantly changing island. Participate in limited-time events, crossovers, and competitive tournaments.

name: League of Legends
description: League of Legends is a multiplayer online battle arena game where two teams of five players compete to destroy the opposing Nexus. Each player controls a unique champion with distinct abilities. Strategic teamwork, map control, and skillful execution are key to victory.

name: Counter-Strike 2
description: Counter-Strike 2 is the biggest technical leap in Counter-Strike history. Built on the Source 2 engine, it features overhauled visuals, responsive smokes that interact with the environment, and refined gameplay mechanics. Join terrorist or counter-terrorist teams in competitive tactical matches.

name: Elden Ring
description: Elden Ring is a massive open-world action RPG crafted by FromSoftware and George R.R. Martin. Journey through the Lands Between, face legendary bosses, uncover ancient lore, and forge your own path as the Tarnished. Features deep lore, punishing combat, and breathtaking landscapes.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Red Dead Redemption 2 is an epic tale of life in America at the dawn of the modern age. Play as outlaw Arthur Morgan navigating loyalty, survival, and redemption across a breathtaking open world. Featuring unparalleled detail, dynamic weather, and an emotional storyline.

name: God of War
description: God of War brings Kratos and his son Atreus to the Norse realms. Battle mythological creatures, solve intricate puzzles, and forge a powerful bond between father and son. Stunning visuals, fluid combat, and an emotional narrative make this a masterpiece of gaming.

name: Hades
description: Hades is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where you play as the immortal Prince of the Underworld. Battle through ever-changing dungeons using the powers of Olympian gods. Each run offers new boons, weapons, and story revelations as you forge your path to the surface.

name: Hollow Knight
description: Hollow Knight is a challenging action-adventure set in the vast underground kingdom of Hallownest. Explore beautifully crafted hand-drawn environments, battle evolved insects, discover ancient secrets, and master precise combat. One of the finest indie games ever created.

name: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
description: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice puts you in the role of a disgraced shinobi in Sengoku Japan. Master the art of stealth, combat, and posture-breaking mechanics to defeat brutal enemies and powerful bosses. A rewarding and deeply satisfying action game from the creators of Dark Souls.

name: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Baldur's Gate 3 is a story-rich, party-based RPG set in the universe of Dungeons & Dragons. Gather your companions, explore a vast world, make impactful choices, and engage in turn-based tactical combat. One of the most acclaimed RPGs ever made with infinite replayability.

name: Stardew Valley
description: Stardew Valley is a charming farming simulation RPG where you inherit your grandfather's old farm. Plant crops, raise animals, mine for resources, fish, and build relationships with the townsfolk. A relaxing, deeply rewarding experience created by a single developer.

name: Among Us
description: Among Us is an online multiplayer social deduction game set in a space-themed setting. Players work to complete tasks aboard a spaceship while impostors secretly sabotage and eliminate crewmates. Use discussion and voting to identify the impostors before it's too late.

name: Apex Legends
description: Apex Legends is a free-to-play battle royale hero shooter set in the Titanfall universe. Choose from a roster of unique Legends with special abilities, form squads of three, and compete in fast-paced matches. Features fluid movement mechanics, innovative ping system, and regular seasonal content.

name: Dota 2
description: Dota 2 is a deep and complex MOBA where two teams of five heroes battle to destroy the enemy Ancient. With over 120 heroes, each offering unique abilities and playstyles, no two matches are the same. Features one of the world's largest esports prize pools annually.

name: Terraria
description: Terraria is a 2D sandbox adventure game packed with exploration, building, crafting, and combat. Dig deep underground to find rare resources, battle hundreds of unique enemies, and challenge epic bosses. With thousands of items and near-endless content, it's one of gaming's best values.

name: Portal 2
description: Portal 2 is a mind-bending first-person puzzle game that uses a portal gun to create dimensional gateways. Solve increasingly complex spatial puzzles through clever thinking, work cooperatively with a partner, and enjoy a witty narrative featuring the iconic antagonist GLaDOS.

name: Disco Elysium
description: Disco Elysium is a groundbreaking open-world RPG with no combat. Play as a deeply flawed detective solving a murder in a decaying city. Your skills are your companions, your choices shape the world, and your failures can be as interesting as your successes.

name: Divinity: Original Sin 2
description: Divinity: Original Sin 2 is a deep turn-based RPG featuring extraordinary levels of freedom. Create your character, recruit companions, and explore a richly detailed world full of secrets. Every choice matters, every character has a story, and every encounter can be solved in multiple ways.

name: Monster Hunter: World
description: Monster Hunter: World is an action RPG where you take on the role of a hunter, tracking and slaying enormous monsters across lush ecosystems. Craft powerful gear from monster materials, master 14 unique weapon types, and team up with friends in epic co-op hunts.

name: Persona 5 Royal
description: Persona 5 Royal is the definitive edition of one of the most stylish JRPGs ever made. Lead a group of Phantom Thieves who steal the corrupt desires from the hearts of adults. Features a rich story, turn-based combat with strategic depth, and unforgettable characters.

name: Death Stranding
description: Death Stranding is Hideo Kojima's genre-defining action game set in a post-apocalyptic America. As Sam Porter Bridges, reconnect a fractured society by delivering cargo across treacherous terrain. A meditative experience about connection, cooperation, and the bonds that hold humanity together.

name: Celeste
description: Celeste is a precision platformer about climbing a mountain and confronting your inner demons. Features tight, rewarding gameplay with hundreds of hand-crafted levels, an emotional story about mental health, and a stunning chiptune soundtrack. Challenging but always fair.

name: NieR: Automata
description: NieR: Automata tells the story of androids 2B, 9S, and A2 fighting a war against machines in a post-apocalyptic Earth. Features fluid hack-and-slash combat, multiple story endings, a haunting soundtrack, and deep philosophical themes about consciousness and what it means to be human.

name: Horizon Zero Dawn
description: Horizon Zero Dawn is an action RPG set in a lush post-apocalyptic world reclaimed by nature and dominated by robotic creatures. Play as Aloy, a skilled hunter uncovering the mysteries of her world. Features spectacular combat against mechanical beasts and a rich story.

name: Resident Evil Village
description: Resident Evil Village continues Ethan Winters' terrifying story as he searches for his kidnapped daughter in a mysterious European village. Face monstrous creatures, explore gothic mansions, and survive against the terrifying Lady Dimitrescu and other powerful lords.

name: Resident Evil 2 Remake
description: The iconic survival horror game Resident Evil 2 is reborn with stunning visuals and modern gameplay. Play as Leon S. Kennedy and Claire Redfield as they fight to survive the zombie outbreak in Raccoon City, stalked by the relentless Tyrant known as Mr. X.

name: Devil May Cry 5
description: Devil May Cry 5 is a stylish action game featuring three demon hunters — Nero, Dante, and the mysterious V. Battle demonic hordes in stunning combo-driven combat, each character offering a unique playstyle. Features jaw-dropping set pieces and an epic demon-slaying story.

name: Mass Effect Legendary Edition
description: The Mass Effect Legendary Edition brings the iconic sci-fi trilogy remastered for modern platforms. Play as Commander Shepard across three games, making choices that ripple throughout the saga. Features over 40 DLC packs, improved visuals, and an epic story about saving the galaxy.

name: Rainbow Six Siege
description: Rainbow Six Siege is a tactical first-person shooter emphasizing destructible environments and operator abilities. Choose from dozens of unique operators, each with special gadgets, to attack or defend objectives. Precise communication, strategy, and teamwork determine victory.

name: Rocket League
description: Rocket League is a high-powered hybrid of arcade-style soccer and vehicular mayhem. Control rocket-powered cars to hit a giant ball into the opponent's goal. With deep mechanical skill ceiling, competitive ranked modes, and constant updates, it remains a beloved esports title.

name: Fall Guys
description: Fall Guys is a massively multiplayer party game with up to 60 players. Race through whimsical obstacle courses, survive chaotic mini-games, and be the last bean standing. Features colourful costumes, seasonal events, and hilarious physics-based gameplay for all ages.

name: Dark Souls III
description: Dark Souls III is the culmination of the Souls series, featuring faster combat, breathtaking boss fights, and a rich interconnected world. Master timing, patience, and resource management to overcome brutal enemies. Features an expansive lore and challenging PvP multiplayer.

name: The Last of Us Part I
description: The Last of Us Part I is a rebuilt-from-the-ground-up version of the acclaimed post-apocalyptic survival game. Follow Joel and Ellie as they journey across a fungus-ravaged America. Features stunning visuals, gripping storytelling, intense stealth gameplay, and emotional character moments.

name: Ghost of Tsushima
description: Ghost of Tsushima is a stunning open-world action game set in feudal Japan during the Mongol invasion of 1274. Play as samurai Jin Sakai, master the way of the Ghost to liberate Tsushima Island. Features gorgeous visuals, fluid sword combat, and a deep honour system.

name: Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered
description: Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered brings Peter Parker's thrilling adventure to PC. Swing across a breathtaking open-world New York City, battle iconic villains, and balance life as both a hero and a person. Features fluid web-swinging, deep combat, and an emotional story.

name: Final Fantasy VII Remake
description: Final Fantasy VII Remake is a spectacular reimagining of one of gaming's greatest stories. Experience Cloud Strife and AVALANCHE's battle against the Shinra Corporation in stunning real-time combat. Features lavish production values, an expanded narrative, and beloved characters redesigned for modern audiences.

name: Final Fantasy XIV Online
description: Final Fantasy XIV is a critically acclaimed MMORPG set in the world of Eorzea. Rebuilt from the ground up after a disastrous launch, it now boasts one of gaming's best stories, a welcoming community, and an enormous amount of content. Play the free trial up to level 60.

name: Overwatch 2
description: Overwatch 2 is a team-based hero shooter where players select from a growing roster of heroes with unique abilities. Compete in 5v5 matches across a variety of modes including Push, Escort, and Control. Features regular seasonal content, cosmetics, and esports-level competition.

name: Destiny 2
description: Destiny 2 is a free-to-play online FPS with RPG elements set in a mythic science-fiction world. Become a Guardian, explore planets, and battle alien threats using powerful weapons and supernatural abilities. Features raids, dungeons, seasonal stories, and rich looter-shooter progression.

name: Path of Exile
description: Path of Exile is a free-to-play dark fantasy action RPG with one of the deepest character customisation systems in gaming. Build your character with thousands of passive skills and unique items. Features challenging end-game content, regular leagues, and a passionate community.

name: Starfield
description: Starfield is Bethesda's first original IP in 25 years, set in space. Explore over 1,000 planets, customise your ship and character, and uncover the mystery of mysterious artifacts. Features the deep open-world exploration and RPG systems Bethesda is known for on a galactic scale.

name: Lies of P
description: Lies of P is a dark Soulslike set in a twisted Belle Époque world inspired by Pinocchio. Play as P, a puppet who must master a unique weapon assembly system and deceptive mechanics. Features challenging bosses, a haunting atmosphere, and a surprisingly emotional narrative.

name: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
description: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon marks FromSoftware's triumphant return to the mech genre. Pilot your fully customisable Armored Core through explosive missions on the resource-rich planet Rubicon 3. Features deep mech assembly, brutal boss fights, and multiple story paths.

name: Sea of Stars
description: Sea of Stars is a turn-based RPG inspired by the classics of the genre. Follow Zale and Valere, children of the solstice, as they use the power of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic. Features stunning pixel art, a rich world, excellent music, and satisfying combat.

name: Dave the Diver
description: Dave the Diver is a charming adventure game combining deep-sea exploration with sushi restaurant management. Dive into a mysterious Blue Hole teeming with marine life, catch fish, and serve them to customers at night. A delightful blend of genres with an irresistible charm.

name: Hi-Fi Rush
description: Hi-Fi Rush is a rhythm-action game where everything moves to the beat of the music. Play as Chai, a wannabe rockstar with a music player fused to his chest, and battle through a colourful world in sync with an incredible soundtrack. Joyful, stylish, and endlessly fun.

name: Hogwarts Legacy
description: Hogwarts Legacy is an immersive open-world action RPG set in the 1800s wizarding world. Attend Hogwarts, learn spells, brew potions, and explore a vast magical landscape beyond the castle walls. Make morally complex choices that shape your story and your character's destiny.

name: Street Fighter 6
description: Street Fighter 6 revitalizes the iconic fighting franchise with a bold new art direction, intuitive Drive system, and the expansive World Tour mode. Battle classic fighters and new challengers, master timing and combos, and rise through the competitive ranks in the definitive modern fighting game.

name: Tekken 8
description: Tekken 8 is the latest instalment in the legendary 3D fighting franchise. Features stunning visuals, an aggressive Heat System that rewards offensive play, a cinematic story mode, and an accessible yet deep combat system. The King of Iron Fist Tournament has never looked better.

name: EA Sports FC 24
description: EA Sports FC 24 marks a new era for football gaming. Powered by HyperMotionV technology, it delivers the most realistic football simulation with true-to-life player movements. Features Ultimate Team, Career Mode, VOLTA Football, and all major leagues and competitions worldwide.

name: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor
description: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor continues Cal Kestis's journey as a Jedi on the run. Fight with five lightsaber stances, explore a galaxy of diverse planets, and uncover an ancient mystery. Features stunning combat, epic Force powers, and a heartfelt story of resilience and hope.

name: Dead Space Remake
description: The Dead Space Remake is a faithful reimagining of the 2008 survival horror classic. Play as Isaac Clarke, an engineer trapped on a nightmarish spaceship overrun by grotesque Necromorphs. Features a seamless world, enhanced audio, improved story, and terrifying atmospheric horror.

name: Returnal
description: Returnal is a third-person shooter roguelike where astronaut Selene crash-lands on an alien planet and is trapped in an endless time loop. Fight through procedurally generated environments, face terrifying bosses, and unravel a deeply unsettling mystery with each cycle.

name: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
description: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart is a stunning platformer that takes the beloved duo through dimensional rifts to new worlds. Features near-instant load transitions, dazzling visuals, creative weapons, and an exciting new character Rivet. A showcase of modern game technology and pure fun.

name: Forza Horizon 5
description: Forza Horizon 5 is the ultimate open-world racing game set across a breathtaking Mexican landscape. Drive hundreds of cars across jungles, deserts, beaches, and ancient ruins. Features seasonal events, co-op adventures, creative builder tools, and stunning photo-realistic visuals.

name: Halo Infinite
description: Halo Infinite brings Master Chief to an expansive open world on a mysterious ringworld called Zeta Halo. Features a thrilling campaign, the iconic multiplayer that defined console shooters, and the beloved Big Team Battle mode. Free-to-play multiplayer with seasonal updates.

name: Age of Empires IV
description: Age of Empires IV is a real-time strategy game that brings the beloved franchise into a new era. Command eight unique civilisations across historical campaigns spanning the Norman Conquest to the Ming Dynasty. Features intuitive gameplay, rich documentary content, and robust multiplayer.

name: Total War: Warhammer III
description: Total War: Warhammer III is the epic conclusion to the fantasy trilogy. Command legendary lords across a vast campaign map, managing your empire in turn-based strategy while fighting spectacular real-time battles. Features daemon factions, Cathay, Kislev, and the realm of Chaos.

name: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
description: Civilization VI is the award-winning strategy game where you build an empire to stand the test of time. Research technologies, establish trade routes, wage war, and pursue diplomatic victories across sprawling procedurally generated maps. Features new district systems and the addictive 'one more turn' gameplay loop.

name: Cities: Skylines
description: Cities: Skylines is the definitive modern city-builder. Plan and grow your city from a small town to a vast metropolis, managing traffic, utilities, zoning, and citizen happiness. Features robust mod support, expansive DLC, and a passionate community creating endless new content.

name: Factorio
description: Factorio is an automation game about building and managing factories. Mine resources, research technologies, build infrastructure, and automate everything to launch a rocket. Incredibly deep, endlessly engaging, and one of the highest-rated games on Steam with near-perfect user reviews.

name: Rust
description: Rust is a multiplayer survival game where the only goal is to survive. Gather resources, craft tools, build bases, and defend yourself against both wild animals and other players. Features a dynamic, brutal player-driven economy and one of gaming's most thrilling social experiences.

name: Valheim
description: Valheim is a Viking survival sandbox game where you explore a vast mystical world of Norse mythology. Build longhouses, forge weapons, sail the seas, and slay legendary bosses to prove your worth to Odin. Supports up to 10 players co-op for a truly epic Viking adventure.

name: Subnautica
description: Subnautica is an underwater open-world survival adventure set on an alien ocean planet. Dive into vast underwater ecosystems, scavenge crashed spaceship parts, build underwater bases, and uncover a mysterious story. A uniquely beautiful and terrifying survival experience.

name: No Man's Sky
description: No Man's Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe. Discover exotic planets teeming with alien flora and fauna, trade with alien civilisations, and build your own bases. Massively improved since launch into one of gaming's greatest comeback stories.

name: Satisfactory
description: Satisfactory is a first-person factory building game set on an alien planet. Build massive automated factories, extract and process alien resources, and explore the world in 3D. Supports co-op multiplayer so you can build the ultimate industrial empire with friends.

name: Deep Rock Galactic
description: Deep Rock Galactic is a 1-4 player co-op first-person shooter where space dwarves mine treacherous alien caves. Choose from four unique classes, fight hordes of bugs, complete objectives, and return to the drop pod safely. Renowned for its incredible community and Rock and Stone spirit.

name: It Takes Two
description: It Takes Two is a genre-defying co-op platformer about a couple on the brink of divorce who must work together to get back to normal. Each level transforms into a completely different gameplay experience. Winner of multiple Game of the Year awards and one of the best co-op games ever made.

name: Cuphead
description: Cuphead is a run-and-gun action game heavily inspired by 1930s cartoons. Battle through a series of relentless boss fights with hand-drawn animation, watercolour backgrounds, and a jazz soundtrack. Incredibly challenging but visually stunning and artistically unmatched.

name: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
description: Ori and the Will of the Wisps is a breathtaking action platformer and one of the most visually stunning games ever made. Guide Ori through a vast world of mystery and peril, meet new characters, and fight formidable enemies. A masterpiece of art, music, and gameplay.

name: Outer Wilds
description: Outer Wilds is an open-world mystery set in a handcrafted solar system trapped in a 22-minute time loop. Explore strange worlds, uncover ancient alien secrets, and piece together what happened — armed only with your curiosity and a trusty spaceship. One of gaming's most profound experiences.

name: Undertale
description: Undertale is a unique RPG where you don't have to kill anyone. Navigate the underground world of monsters, befriend enemies instead of fighting them, and uncover a touching story about determination and love. Features multiple endings, memorable characters, and a legendary soundtrack.

name: Inscryption
description: Inscryption is an inky black card-based odyssey blending deckbuilding, roguelike elements, and sinister escape-room puzzles into a uniquely dark narrative experience. More than just a card game, it is a meta mystery that constantly subverts your expectations in shocking ways.

name: Phasmophobia
description: Phasmophobia is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror game where you and your team investigate haunted locations to gather evidence of paranormal activity. Communicate with ghosts, use specialist equipment, and identify the ghost type before it hunts you down.

name: Sons of the Forest
description: Sons of the Forest is a survival horror game where you are sent to find a missing billionaire on a remote island, only to be trapped in a cannibal-infested hell. Build bases, craft weapons, and survive with your AI companion Kelvin. A stunning and terrifying survival experience.

name: Atomic Heart
description: Atomic Heart is a first-person shooter set in an alternate Soviet Union of the 1950s where robots have gone rogue. Explore bizarre and stunning environments, fight mechanical monstrosities, and wield a unique polymer glove alongside a diverse arsenal of weapons.

name: Control
description: Control is a supernatural third-person action game set in a brutalist government building called the Oldest House. Play as Jesse Faden, wielding telekinetic powers and a shape-shifting weapon to battle terrifying forces. Dripping with atmosphere, mystery, and incredible world-building.

name: Dragon's Dogma 2
description: Dragon's Dogma 2 is a single-player fantasy action RPG featuring a richly realised open world. Build your own custom hero, recruit Pawns as companions, and battle enormous monsters using a deeply satisfying physics-based combat system. Features incredible emergent gameplay moments.

name: Like a Dragon: Ishin!
description: Like a Dragon: Ishin! is a historical action RPG set during Japan's Bakumatsu period. Play as Sakamoto Ryoma on a quest for justice through the streets of Kyoto. Combines the beloved Yakuza combat with a rich period drama narrative featuring iconic series characters in new roles.

name: Persona 4 Golden
description: Persona 4 Golden is a beloved JRPG set in the rural town of Inaba where a series of mysterious murders unfold. Enter the mysterious TV world, recruit Personas, and build meaningful relationships with classmates. Features a heartwarming story, excellent turn-based combat, and a legendary soundtrack.

name: Yakuza 0
description: Yakuza 0 is the perfect entry point into the beloved Yakuza series. Set in 1988 Japan, play as both Kazuma Kiryu and Majima Goro as their destinies intertwine in a gripping tale of power, money, and loyalty. Features brutal brawler combat, incredible side content, and a gripping crime story.

name: Death's Door
description: Death's Door is an isometric action game where you play as a crow reaper collecting souls. Explore a beautifully detailed world filled with challenging enemies, memorable bosses, and hidden secrets. Features precise combat, clever puzzle design, and a surprisingly touching story.

name: Tunic
description: Tunic is a gorgeous isometric action-adventure starring a tiny fox hero exploring a mysterious world. Discover fragments of an in-game instruction manual in an unknown language, unravel the game's secrets, and face challenging foes and bosses. A love letter to classic adventure games.

name: Neon White
description: Neon White is a lightning-fast first-person action game about killing demons in heaven. Collect soul cards to gain weapons and movement abilities, speed-run through stylish stages, and uncover a story of assassins competing for a place in paradise. Addictively fast and uniquely creative.

name: Sifu
description: Sifu is a relentless third-person kung fu brawler where you play as a young student seeking revenge. You age each time you die, with death becoming permanent at 70. Master kung fu through repetition, learn enemy patterns, and push through five challenging environments to avenge your family.

name: Ghostrunner
description: Ghostrunner is a hardcore first-person action game set in a brutal cyberpunk world. One hit kills you, one hit kills enemies. Slash, dash, and wall-run your way up a towering megastructure, mastering the perfect run through lightning-fast reflex-based gameplay.

name: The Forgotten City
description: The Forgotten City is an award-winning mystery adventure game set in an ancient Roman city. One person sins and everyone dies — use time loops and your knowledge of the inhabitants to prevent the catastrophe. Features multiple endings, rich dialogue, and a gripping detective story.

name: Vampire Survivors
description: Vampire Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelike elements. Survive waves of relentless monsters, collect power-ups, and evolve your weapons into devastating tools of destruction. An addictive, endlessly satisfying gameplay loop at an incredible price point.

name: Diablo IV
description: Diablo IV is a dark action RPG returning the series to its gritty roots. Battle through the world of Sanctuary against the forces of Hell, choosing from five unique classes. Features a massive open world, deep seasonal content, brutal endgame activities, and co-op play.

name: Microsoft Flight Simulator
description: Microsoft Flight Simulator uses satellite data and AI to recreate the entire planet Earth with stunning accuracy. Fly any aircraft from a bush plane to a commercial jet across any location in the world. A breathtaking technical achievement and the most realistic flight simulation ever made.

name: Forza Horizon 4
description: Forza Horizon 4 is a stunning open-world racing game set across a beautifully realised Britain that changes with the seasons. Race on country roads, through ancient castles, and along coastal cliffs. Features hundreds of cars, a vibrant online world, and incredible seasonal events.

name: DayZ
description: DayZ is a hardcore open-world survival game set in a zombie-infested post-Soviet state. Scavenge for food, medicine, and weapons while managing hunger, thirst, and disease. The greatest threat is often other players. Every encounter is tense, every death is permanent, every survival story unique.

name: Arma 3
description: Arma 3 is the premier military simulation game featuring massive open-world environments and authentic military tactics. Engage in large-scale infantry, vehicular, and aerial combat across the Mediterranean islands of Altis and Stratis. Features an incredible modding community and endless user-created content.

name: Half-Life: Alyx
description: Half-Life: Alyx is Valve's return to the Half-Life universe and the pinnacle of VR gaming. Set before Half-Life 2, play as Alyx Vance in a desperate battle against the alien Combine. Features groundbreaking VR interaction, incredible atmosphere, and a satisfying conclusion that shook the gaming world.

name: ARK: Survival Ascended
description: ARK: Survival Ascended is a full Unreal Engine 5 remake of the beloved survival game. Tame and breed dinosaurs, build bases, and survive in a prehistoric open world with friends. Features stunning next-gen visuals, overhauled gameplay systems, and cross-platform multiplayer.
